{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Rebar → `uPunchingRebar`
{{% /callout %}}

Places punching-shear reinforcement around a column in fifteen layouts (central, external and corner, five variants each). Items are rebar groups, rebar meshes, or stud-rail embeds. Defaults are the standard set shipped with the package. For rebar groups and meshes the cover, height and overhangs are bar-surface and outside dimensions. The tool passes its native suite (18692 checks) on Tekla 2026; the dialog's Modify, Get and Save/Load paths are not yet tested in Tekla.

<blockquote class="page-note">The Tekla plugin string is <code>uPunchingRebar</code>. Components placed by the earlier Clone builds (<code>uPunchingRebarClone</code>) may not be recognised by it; see <a href="../rebar-upgrade/">Upgrading from the earlier Clone builds</a>. Sets saved under the earlier dialog name are carried over with the <a href="../rebar-upgrade/">preset migration helper</a>.</blockquote>
